title: Tracking
description: herb's Times Square night photo, smeared into vertical streaks and drifting like handheld footage, with live blob tracking running on every frame: thin green boxes lock onto the signs and headlights, each with a number and a line of lisp, and your pointer is a tracked blob that fans lines out to the nearest lights.
intent: The TouchDesigner blob-tracking edit, done for real: bright regions are found with connected-component labelling on a downscaled buffer each frame and held steady by a tracker in image space, so the boxes stick to the street while the camera breathes.
sources: herb reference board: Pinterest video #896638607050931780 (blob tracking over pixel-sorted footage)
